# Golden Valley Kids Pediatric Dentistry & Orthodontics

> > Comprehensive pediatric dental and orthodontic care serving Minneapolis-area families with expert preventive and specialized treatment for children.

Golden Valley Kids is a pediatric dentistry and orthodontics practice located in Golden Valley, Minnesota, serving the greater Minneapolis area including Saint Louis Park, Plymouth, Edina, New Hope, and Minnetonka. The practice specializes in pediatric dental care, orthodontics, preventive care, and treatment for children with special needs.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric dentistry
- Orthodontics
- Children's dental care
- Preventive care
- Early childhood caries
- Special needs dentistry

- Golden Valley

- WCAG accessibility
